description: This shell script sets up and tests the behavior of a Git hook (`post-commit`) in a scenario involving nested Git repositories and moving the `.git` directory. It verifies that hooks are correctly invoked when performing commits from different directory contexts, including when the `.git` directory is relocated.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.
